svg.title: MVM unit: one cluster, DDR4 weight beats to the SPM write
svg.desc: tsr_mvm, shared by all clusters, reads the QA lines from the SPM read port and broadcasts the setup of the MVM tile op, which starts the cluster's weight requests, then the lines through each cluster's own tsr_vpipe into the cluster's activation buffer. DDR4 channel c streams weight beats into the front end (stream requester with a 512-beat FIFO, chunk parser, meta + unpack); tagged beats enter the back end once the activation buffer is complete: 4 MAC lanes, integer scale, 2 x i2f, fmul d*Dx, block term, accumulate into 16 partials per row, tree16. Row results return through the cluster's tsr_rpipe to the shared gather, which writes 16 rows per SPM line, or with ACC reads the old line and adds first. Planned, drawn dashed: the attention modes ATTQK and ATTPV, with the p broadcast and gather ATT path in tsr_mvm and the w-unit, capture bank and convert pipes in the cluster.
